name: Titanium Profiles
notes:
- Updates: a check that fails after a version was verified keeps Show in Finder instead of offering Download again; after "a newer version is already installed", the same update is no longer offered again; a downloaded update kept across a restart is checked again in full and used, and one cut short or no longer offered is deleted; Install and Relaunch and Download act on the version shown, even while an automatic check runs.
- Logs: choosing another log shows "Loading…" instead of the previous log under the new name; a rotation while paused no longer mixes entries of the old and the new file; two MCP server logs whose names differ only by a final number are no longer mixed up; logs -f no longer loses entries after a rotation.
- Moving a removed profile's data to the Trash says what went and what stayed when it fails partway, keeps a profile folder that is a link, and takes the whole profile folder after the profiles folder was changed. A Claude Code folder picked by hand next to a profile's data now shows as Custom, and is kept.
- Also fixed: Diagnostics says again which value is out of range; a profile that cannot be created leaves no empty folders; two profiles started at the same moment both keep their last start; screen readers hear the count of each new log filter; smaller fixes in Settings, the dashboard and Statistics.
